entities.name: Juan Gazsó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Gazsó was a Serbian-born Argentine basketball player who competed in the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was born in Telečka, Zapadna Bačka, Serbia and died in Córdoba, Argentina.
